title: AWS Lambda Secrets Manager with PowerTools
description: Lambda function that uses PowerTools to get Secrets Manager secret and call an API.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern creates an AWS Lambda function to call a protected API endpoint using an API Key retrieved using Lambda Powertools from AWS SecretsManager. It is deployed with the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) in Python.

testing.headline: Testing
text: See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
